---
name: validate-library
description: Lint, test and build the vempain-auth-frontend library with the checked-in Yarn 4 and verify what gets published. Use before reporting any change as done.
---

# Validate vempain-auth-frontend

- Checked-in Yarn 4 (`.yarn/releases`, `yarnPath`); install with `yarn install --immutable`.
- Run `yarn lint`, `yarn test`, `yarn build`; all must be clean.
- `tsconfig.build.json` excludes tests and emits `dist/` with declarations; only `dist/` is published. `src/buildInfo.json` is generated by
  `generateBuildInfo.js` (derived artifact). Never commit `dist/`, `coverage/`, `node_modules/`.
- Jest: `ts-jest` under `node` (`jest.config.js`, `tsconfig.jest.json`); component tests opt into jsdom with a docblock and stub antd's
  browser APIs.
- CI: `frontend-library.yaml` from `vempain-workflows` publishes to GitHub Packages on `main` with the version from `VERSION`; bump it for
  every published change and update the consuming SPAs' `package.json`.
